searches_tried: pipeline comps.py: 'australian stamps album', 'KGV stamps collection', 'kiloware stamps box'; work comps.py: 'australia stamps lot'. Only generic box and accumulation comps found, no same-item match.
chrome_hint: eBay sold (Australia): 'australia stamps kiloware box lot' and 'australian stamps collection album KGV KGVI lot'; Terapeak on the same; Leski, Noble Numismatics and Status International recent results for 'Australia stamps accumulation box' and 'KGV heads album'. Look for sold boxes of kiloware/off-paper at roughly this size.
viewing_check: Open the album and check every page behind the Australia page: KGV heads (look for 1/4, 5d, 6d, Kangaroos, Kookaburra), anything pre-1930, states or commemoratives. Look in several bags for older covers, mint blocks, or foreign better material. Check the Tudor exercise book for stuck-down stamps or stockbook contents. Photograph the best pages.
